gameplay.step: boot into attract with a full trough (the power-on coil pulses happen in this window)
Start with a credit and a full trough: the ROM resets both drop banks and serves a ball
the served ball leaves the trough eject position (36 clears)

gameplay.reading: COMPLETE 3 MORE POOL GAMES FOR CUTTHROAT COUNTDOWN
gameplay.step: the ball reaches the shooter lane (43)
the ball leaves the shooter lane
play with every target standing: control window
hold the left flipper button bit (84)
release the left flipper button bit
hold the right flipper button bit (82)
release the right flipper button bit
hold public 21 (the ROM's UR. FLIPPER switch)
hold public 81 (the flipper column's lower-right end-of-stroke bit, which CAPCOM.VBS writes for a staged right flipper key)
right bank control: public 48 alone to 1 (the address both community tables give the right bank's first target)
right bank as the community tables number it: 48 down
